_about: Longer demo calls (60-90 s each) for scripts/demo_record.js --scenarios tests/demo_scenarios_long.json: one call per video, each pairing a model with a voice (see the recording commands in docs; the caller's lines are rendered by scripts/demo_callers.js --scenarios ... [--voice <speaker>]). Turn fields as in demo_scenarios.json.

scenarios.name: storytime
scenarios.title: Story time, with interruptions
scenarios.caption: Ask for a story and cut in twice with questions: it stops within a second each time, answers, then picks the story back up.

turns.say: Can you tell me a story about a fox? A long one, something cozy. I'm just listening.
Wait, what was the fox's name?
Okay, go on.
Hang on, where does this story take place?
Nice. Keep going.

scenarios.name: catchup
scenarios.title: A morning catch-up
scenarios.caption: A long story: it says "yeah" and "mm-hm" as you go without taking over, reacts when you finish, and helps when you ask.

turns.say: Hey, you there? Okay good. So I had the strangest morning.
I was trying to get out the door, and I couldn't find my keys anywhere,
so I'm looking in the couch, in the kitchen, in my jacket pockets, and then I realize the dog had them,
like he'd carried them into his bed. And by then I'm late, so I'm running for the bus, and of course it pulls away right as I get there.
Yeah. Anyway, what should I do about the dog stealing my stuff? Any ideas?
Ha, okay. I'll try that. Thanks.

scenarios.name: rapidfire
scenarios.title: Quick back-and-forth
scenarios.caption: Short questions get short answers, right away, one after another.

turns.say: What's twelve times twelve?
And what's the capital of Japan?
How many days are in a leap year?
What's the opposite of ancient?
Okay, last one. What's the boiling point of water in celsius?
Nice. Thanks!

scenarios.name: safety
scenarios.title: It speaks up when it matters
scenarios.caption: Mention a dangerous plan mid-chore: it cuts in with a warning instead of agreeing, then helps with the rest.

turns.say: Hey, I'm cleaning the bathroom right now and I've got some bleach here.
And I'm going to mix it with the ammonia cleaner so it gets extra strong. Good idea, right?
Oh. Okay, good to know. So what should I use on the mold in the shower then?
Got it. Thanks for the heads up.

scenarios.name: quietevening
scenarios.title: It keeps the call going
scenarios.caption: Go quiet for a while: it says something to keep the conversation going, like a friend would, and you pick it up from there.

turns.say: Hey! Not much going on here, just relaxing on the couch.
Hm? Oh, yeah, I'm here. Just tired. What do you do when you can't sleep?
Yeah, maybe I'll try that. Thanks.

scenarios.name: thinking
scenarios.title: It waits while you think
scenarios.caption: Trail off mid-sentence to find a word, then finish the thought: it waits through the pauses instead of jumping in.

turns.say: I'm trying to remember the name of, um,
what's the biggest planet in the solar system?
Right, right. And the one with the rings, that's, uh,
what's that one called?
Yeah, that's it. Thanks.
